name.zh: 臺灣經典老車站 6 選

description.zh: 從內灣到菁桐，走過六座留著木造月台與鐵道記憶的車站。
description.en: Six stations that still carry the memory of Taiwan's old rail lines.

name.zh: 古蹟尋跡：六座見證統治者更迭的建築
name.en: Heritage Trail: Six Landmarks, Six Eras

description.zh: 從艋舺老街到金門城樓，六座古蹟見證了荷蘭人、清朝與日本人先後在此留下的痕跡。
description.en: From an old Taipei neighborhood to a Kinmen watchtower — six landmarks spanning the Dutch, Qing, and Japanese eras.

description.zh: 古蹟、車站、圖書館與一碗豆花——臺南是走出來的。
description.en: Forts, a station, a library, and a bowl of tofu pudding — Tainan is best explored on foot.

description.zh: 六座館，六種看世界的方式。
description.en: Six museums, six ways of looking at the world.

description.zh: 威士忌、巧克力、蠟筆與漢餅，六種被做出來的味道。
description.en: Whisky, chocolate, crayons and pastry — six things you can watch being made.

description.zh: 六座圖書館，六個城市最安靜的地方。
description.en: Six libraries — the quietest room in six cities.

description.zh: 從一碗麵線開始，把台灣吃過一遍。
description.en: Start with a bowl of noodles and eat your way across Taiwan.

name.en: 6 Botanical Gardens and Forest Parks Worth the Trip

description.zh: 從碧潭邊的二叭子到瑞穗的樟樹林，六座植物園與森林遊樂區，適合放慢腳步、聞著草木呼吸。
description.en: From a quiet garden by Bitan to a camphor forest in Ruisui — six botanical gardens and forest parks worth slowing down for.

description.zh: 從上野的博物館到淺草寺，再到築地吃一輪，六個地方認識東京。
description.en: From the museum in Ueno to Senso-ji and breakfast at Tsukiji, six places to start with Tokyo.

description.zh: 清水寺、千本鳥居、嵐山竹林與錦市場，京都要慢慢走。
description.en: Kiyomizu-dera, the torii of Fushimi Inari, the Arashiyama bamboo and Nishiki Market: Kyoto is best taken slowly.

description.zh: 大阪城、黑門市場、中之島的美術館和圖書館，再去池田做一杯自己的杯麵。
description.en: Osaka Castle, Kuromon Market, the museum and library on Nakanoshima, then your own Cup Noodles in Ikeda.

name.zh: 北海道：甜點、啤酒與花田

description.zh: 札幌的白色戀人與啤酒博物館、小樽的老車站，夏天再到富良野看薰衣草。
description.en: Shiroi Koibito and the beer museum in Sapporo, Otaru's old station, and Furano's lavender in summer.

description.zh: 從那霸的首里城和市場，一路往北到萬座毛與美麗海水族館。
description.en: From Shuri Castle and the markets of Naha north to Cape Manzamo and the Churaumi Aquarium.

description.zh: 築地、錦市場、黑門市場到牧志公設市場，四座市場邊走邊吃。
description.en: Tsukiji, Nishiki, Kuromon and Makishi: four markets to eat your way through.

description.zh: 從大三巴、議事亭前地到媽閣廟，再去氹仔看葡式老房子，最後在路環吃一顆蛋塔。
description.en: From the Ruins of St. Paul's and Senado Square to A-Ma Temple, then the Taipa Houses and an egg tart in Coloane.

description.zh: 從景福宮走進北村韓屋村，再到舊首爾站、舊市廳和國立中央博物館，看首爾的過去。
description.en: From Gyeongbokgung into the hanok lanes of Bukchon, then the old Seoul Station, the old City Hall and the National Museum of Korea.

description.zh: 東大門設計廣場、星空圖書館、廣藏市場，沿清溪川散步，最後上南山看夜景。
description.en: Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Starfield Library and Gwangjang Market, a walk along Cheonggyecheon, then up Namsan for the view.

description.zh: 從札嘎其市場和甘川洞文化村，到太宗台的斷崖、海雲台的海岸列車和海邊的龍宮寺。
description.en: From Jagalchi Market and Gamcheon Culture Village to the cliffs of Taejongdae, the Haeundae seaside train and the temple by the sea.

description.zh: 城山日出峰看日出、涉地可支走海岬，再到茶園喝綠茶、東門市場吃宵夜。
description.en: Sunrise at Seongsan Ilchulbong, the Seopjikoji headland, green tea among the fields and a late snack at Dongmun Market.

description.zh: 西九的兩座博物館、尖沙咀鐘樓，搭山頂纜車上太平山，晚上逛廟街。
description.en: The two museums in West Kowloon, the Tsim Sha Tsui clock tower, the Peak Tram up to Victoria Peak and Temple Street at night.

name.en: Hong Kong Old Streets and Temples

description.zh: 上環文武廟、結志街的絲襪奶茶、大埔舊車站，再到大嶼山看天壇大佛。
description.en: Man Mo Temple, milk tea on Gage Street, the old Tai Po station and the Big Buddha on Lantau.

description.zh: 從歌劇院、岩石區到皇家植物園，再去維多利亞女王大廈和新的雪梨魚市場。
description.en: From the Opera House and The Rocks to the Royal Botanic Garden, then the QVB and the new Sydney Fish Market.

description.zh: 福林德斯街車站出發，走到州立圖書館、維多利亞女王市場和皇家展覽館。
description.en: Start at Flinders Street Station, then the State Library, Queen Victoria Market and the Royal Exhibition Building.

name.zh: 昆士蘭：布里斯本與凱恩斯

description.zh: 布里斯本的南岸公園、無尾熊和啤酒廠，再到凱恩斯搭觀光火車上庫蘭達。
description.en: South Bank, koalas and a brewery in Brisbane, then the scenic railway up to Kuranda from Cairns.

description.zh: 奧克蘭的博物館、火山丘和魚市場，再去哈比村和羅托魯瓦的地熱谷。
description.en: Auckland's museum, volcano and fish market, then Hobbiton and the geothermal valley at Rotorua.

description.zh: 基督城火車站和植物園，皇后鎮的天空纜車與漢堡，最後到蒂卡波湖畔的小教堂。
description.en: Christchurch's station and gardens, the Skyline and a burger in Queenstown, then the chapel on Lake Tekapo.

description.zh: 戰後重建的老城與皇家城堡、猶太人歷史博物館，再到屋頂花園和美食市集。
description.en: The rebuilt Old Town and Royal Castle, the POLIN museum, a rooftop library garden and a food hall.

description.zh: 中央廣場、聖母聖殿和瓦維爾城堡，猶太區吃烤法棍披薩，再到維利奇卡鹽礦。
description.en: The Main Market Square, St. Mary's and Wawel, zapiekanka in Kazimierz, then the Wieliczka Salt Mine.

description.zh: 大英博物館、國家美術館、倫敦塔和西敏寺，再搭倫敦眼、到邱園散步。
description.en: The British Museum, the National Gallery, the Tower and Westminster Abbey, then the London Eye and a walk in Kew.

description.zh: 大英圖書館和 Daunt Books、波羅市場和哈洛德百貨，從希斯洛機場到聖潘克拉斯車站。
description.en: The British Library and Daunt Books, Borough Market and Harrods, from Heathrow to St Pancras.

description.zh: 城堡、皇家哩大道上的威士忌，最後爬上亞瑟王座看整座城。
description.en: The castle, whisky on the Royal Mile, then up Arthur's Seat for the view.

description.zh: 自由女神、帝國大廈、中央車站和中央公園，再看大都會與自然史博物館。
description.en: The Statue of Liberty, the Empire State Building, Grand Central and Central Park, then the Met and the natural history museum.

description.zh: 公共圖書館的石獅、Strand 書店、雀兒喜市場，晚上到麥迪遜廣場花園看球。
description.en: The library lions, Strand, Chelsea Market, and a game at Madison Square Garden.

description.zh: 金門大橋、渡輪大廈市集、搭船上惡魔島，最後在北灘喝一杯咖啡。
description.en: The Golden Gate Bridge, the Ferry Building, a boat to Alcatraz and a coffee in North Beach.

description.zh: 格里菲斯天文台和蓋蒂中心，再去迪士尼樂園和環球影城。
description.en: Griffith Observatory and the Getty Center, then Disneyland and Universal Studios.

description.zh: 派克市場看魚販拋魚，再上太空針塔。
description.en: Fish-throwing at Pike Place Market, then up the Space Needle.

description.zh: CN 塔、皇家安大略博物館、聖勞倫斯市場和卡薩羅馬城堡，再去看馬蹄瀑布。
description.en: The CN Tower, the ROM, St. Lawrence Market and Casa Loma, then Horseshoe Falls.

description.zh: 史丹利公園的圖騰柱與水族館、格蘭維爾島市場，再走一趟卡皮拉諾吊橋。
description.en: Stanley Park's totem poles and aquarium, Granville Island Market and the Capilano Suspension Bridge.

description.zh: 蒙特婁聖母大教堂的藍色拱頂，和魁北克舊城上的芳堤娜城堡。
description.en: The blue vaults of Notre-Dame in Montréal and the Château Frontenac above Old Québec.

name.zh: 開羅、吉薩與亞歷山大港

description.zh: 金字塔與大埃及博物館、開羅老城的市集和清真寺，再到海邊的亞歷山大圖書館。
description.en: The pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum, old Cairo's bazaar and mosque, then the library by the sea in Alexandria.

description.zh: 路克索的卡納克神廟和帝王谷，一路往南到阿布辛貝神殿。
description.en: Karnak and the Valley of the Kings at Luxor, then south to Abu Simbel.

description.zh: 從臺大椰林大道、東大赤門、京大時計台，到港大、延世、雪梨和墨爾本大學。
description.en: From NTU's palm avenue, UTokyo's Red Gate and Kyoto's clock tower to HKU, Yonsei, Sydney and Melbourne.

description.zh: 走上歌劇院的屋頂、看孟克的《吶喊》和維格蘭雕塑公園，再到美食市集吃一輪。
description.en: Walk up the Opera House roof, see Munch and the Vigeland sculptures, then eat at Mathallen.

description.zh: 卑爾根的布呂根木屋和魚市場、搭纜車上弗洛伊恩山，再搭弗洛姆鐵道，最後到北極圈的特羅姆瑟。
description.en: Bergen's Bryggen and fish market, the funicular up Fløyen, the Flåm Railway, then Tromsø above the Arctic Circle.

description.zh: 舊城大廣場、市政廳、瓦薩沉船和斯堪森，喝杯咖啡配肉桂捲，再到哥德堡的遊樂園。
description.en: Gamla Stan, City Hall, the Vasa and Skansen, a coffee and cinnamon bun, then Liseberg in Gothenburg.

description.zh: 白色大教堂、岩石教堂、Oodi 圖書館和老市場大廳，搭渡輪到芬蘭堡，最後在海邊小木屋喝咖啡。
description.en: The white cathedral, the Rock Church, Oodi and the Old Market Hall, a ferry to Suomenlinna and coffee in a seaside cabin.

description.zh: 在羅瓦涅米跨過北極圈、拜訪聖誕老人村，再到北極博物館認識極地。
description.en: Cross the Arctic Circle at Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi, then learn about the north at Arktikum.
